7751.title: ACP compaction updates are not normalized
7751.rootCauseOneLine: ACP initialization omits session compaction support and the translator routes automatic compaction notifications to provider/unhandled instead of timeline lifecycle events.
7751.proposedFix: Implement and validate the complete ID-addressed ACP compaction lifecycle without replacing the running turn, then advertise the capability. Public-protocol/schema changes exclude this repair from the automatic simple-fix gate.
7751.caveats: Provider-event boundary reproduction, not live desktop/adapter validation. Broad build fails on missing built GitHub-plugin SDK outputs; focused Turbo prerequisites and the existing 91-test translation suite pass. Same agent verified a second clean checkout.
